exposure: umbilical cord blood vitamin A levels
outcome: umbilical cord blood vitamin A level
cohort: 208 late-preterm infants (34 0/7 to 36 6/7 weeks gestational age)
finding: Low umbilical cord blood vitamin A levels were common among late-preterm infants and were not an independent risk factor for morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with lower umbilical cord blood vitamin A levels compared to vaginal delivery.
